summary.headline: Determining the Hyleg and Life Years
summary.text: Instructions for determining the Hyleg and the giver of years, months, and days from the prevention degree or ascendant, depending on their placement and conjunctions with house or term lords; the procedure applies by day and night using the Sun, Moon, Part of Fortune, conjunction or prevention, and ascending degree.
